jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect and Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission Overview:

Keystone Solutions is seeking a Senior Solution Architect and Data Engineer to join our consultancy mission at a client site, focusing on the migration to Microsoft Fabric. As a key partner within the team, you will leverage your expertise to analyze challenges, identify optimal solutions, and facilitate shared decision-making. Your role will involve guiding technical and organizational choices, ensuring a secure migration path, and fostering team buy-in for the selected solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

In this consultancy role, you will:

Provide strategic advice and support to project teams on technical directions, migration scenarios, and best practices for Microsoft Fabric.
Facilitate architecture workshops and technical arbitrations, engaging all stakeholders in the decision-making process.
Ensure decisions are made collaboratively, documented, and aligned with project objectives.
Offer an independent and critical perspective on proposed options to identify risks and opportunities.
Define and validate the target architecture for Microsoft Fabric.
Co-create and maintain the migration roadmap.
Establish architecture, development, governance, and operational standards.
Conduct impact analyses and provide necessary technical recommendations throughout the project phases.
Define the data governance framework with the team.
Ensure adherence to data quality best practices.
Validate security, access management, and compliance principles.
Oversee the coherence of solutions implemented across the platform.
Support teams in migrating data, processes, semantic models, and Power BI reports.
Validate migration strategies and transition plans.
Proactively identify technical risks and propose mitigation plans.
Ensure quality, performance, and cost control objectives are met.
Provide daily support to team members and implement a structured knowledge transfer plan.
Formalize standards, methods, and best practices for the project.
Encourage the gradual autonomy of internal teams on Microsoft Fabric.
Contribute to the skill development of Front-End, Back-End, Architects, and data governance leads.
Monitor technical indicators and project risks.
Ensure the overall coherence of implemented solutions.
Assist in resolving complex issues.
Ensure the organization has the necessary skills, processes, and documentation to operate and evolve the platform independently by the end of the project.
Ensure migration, adoption, and knowledge transfer objectives are achieved.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

Minimum 10 years of experience in Data, BI, Analytics, or Cloud.
Minimum 5 years of experience in solution architecture and technical leadership.
Minimum 3 years of significant experience with the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.
Proven experience in migrating or modernizing enterprise-scale Data and Analytics platforms.
Experience in supporting multidisciplinary teams and knowledge transfer.
Experience in organizational transformation contexts and adopting new platforms.

Key Skills:

Enterprise architecture and solution architecture.
Microsoft Fabric.
Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and modern analytical models.
Data governance.
Security, access management, and compliance.
Data continuity and resilience.
Urbanization and integration of Data platforms.
Advanced SQL.
Python.
Spark / PySpark.
ETL / ELT.
Data Factory.
OneLake.
Performance and cost optimization.
Power BI.
Semantic Models.
DAX.
Reporting and Analytics.
Data Visualization and Data Storytelling.
Azure DevOps.
Git.
CI/CD.
DataOps.
Monitoring and observability.
Orchestration.
Influential leadership.
Facilitation of decision workshops.
Coaching and mentoring.
Risk management.
Communication with teams and management.
Ability to foster consensus and collective decision-making.

Expected Results:

Validated and adopted Microsoft Fabric architecture by the team.
Collaboratively and documented technical decisions.
Migration completed on time and according to defined standards.
Operational governance, security, and data quality.
Team autonomy on Microsoft Fabric at the end of the project.
Reduced dependency on external consultants through effective knowledge transfer.
Established sustainable methods and practices for future platform developments.

Desired Certifications:

Strongly recommended: DP-700 – Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate, AZ-305 – Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
Preferred: DP-600 – Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate, PL-300 – Power BI Data Analyst Associate, TOGAF, Agile Certification (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent).

If you are ready to tackle technical and strategic challenges in a dynamic consultancy environment, apply today at Keystone Solutions Career Portal.

Duration:
01/01/2027 - 31/12/2027 12 months

(full time)

Solution Architecture - Level: Expert - Most recent: This year
